description: Resource Type definition for AWS::Route53::TrafficPolicyInstance. Applies a version of a Route 53 traffic policy to a DNS name in a public hosted zone, and Route 53 creates and owns the resource record sets that answer queries for that name.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the traffic policy instance.
Arn.markdownDescription:
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the traffic policy instance.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Pattern: ^arn:aws[a-zA-Z0-9-]*:route53:::trafficpolicyinstance/[^/\s]{1,36}$  
Update requires: No interruption
Read only property: Yes

Id.description: The ID that Amazon Route 53 assigned to the traffic policy instance when it was created.
Id.markdownDescription:
The ID that Amazon Route 53 assigned to the traffic policy instance when it was created.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 1  
Maximum Length: 36  
Update requires: No interruption
Read only property: Yes

HostedZoneId.description: The ID of the hosted zone that Amazon Route 53 creates the resource record sets in. The bare ID as Route 53 returns it, without a /hostedzone/ prefix.
HostedZoneId.markdownDescription:
The ID of the hosted zone that Amazon Route 53 creates the resource record sets in. The bare ID as Route 53 returns it, without a /hostedzone/ prefix.

---

Required: Yes  
Type: String  
Maximum Length: 32  
Pattern: ^[A-Z0-9]{1,32}$  
Update requires: Replacement

Name.description: The domain name, or subdomain name, for which Amazon Route 53 answers DNS queries by using the resource record sets it creates for this traffic policy instance. Must be lower-case and end with a trailing dot, which is the form Route 53 returns: Route 53 normalizes DNS names, so admitting another form would neither round-trip through Read nor guarantee that a change to this property changes the resource's identity.
Name.markdownDescription:
The domain name, or subdomain name, for which Amazon Route 53 answers DNS queries by using the resource record sets it creates for this traffic policy instance. Must be lower-case and end with a trailing dot, which is the form Route 53 returns: Route 53 normalizes DNS names, so admitting another form would neither round-trip through Read nor guarantee that a change to this property changes the resource's identity.

---

Required: Yes  
Type: String  
Maximum Length: 1024  
Pattern: ^[^A-Z\s]+\.$  
Update requires: Replacement

TTL.description: The TTL that Amazon Route 53 assigns to all of the resource record sets that it creates in the specified hosted zone.
TTL.markdownDescription:
The TTL that Amazon Route 53 assigns to all of the resource record sets that it creates in the specified hosted zone.

---

Required: Yes  
Type: Integer  
Update requires: No interruption

TrafficPolicyId.description: The ID of the traffic policy that Amazon Route 53 uses to create resource record sets in the specified hosted zone. Lower-case, as Route 53 returns it.
TrafficPolicyId.markdownDescription:
The ID of the traffic policy that Amazon Route 53 uses to create resource record sets in the specified hosted zone. Lower-case, as Route 53 returns it.

---

Required: Yes  
Type: String

Maximum Length: 36

Update requires: No interruption

TrafficPolicyVersion.description: The version of the traffic policy that Amazon Route 53 uses to create resource record sets in the specified hosted zone.
TrafficPolicyVersion.markdownDescription:
The version of the traffic policy that Amazon Route 53 uses to create resource record sets in the specified hosted zone.

---

Required: Yes  
Type: Integer  
Update requires: No interruption

State.description: The current state of the traffic policy instance. A steady-state instance is Applied.

The current state of the traffic policy instance. A steady-state instance is Applied.
